en.title: Future continuous and future perfect
en.summary: The future continuous shows an action in progress; the future perfect shows one that will be finished.

paragraphs: These two tenses look forward to a moment in the future and say what will be happening then (future continuous) or what will already have finished (future perfect).

items: This time tomorrow I **will be flying** to Madrid.
By Friday I **will have finished** the report.
In ten years she **will have been** a doctor for a long time.

paragraphs: Form it with will be + the -ing form. It describes an action in progress at a future time, or an event that is already planned and will happen in the normal course of events.

blocks.html:
FormExample
statementI will be working at nine.
questionWill you be using the car tonight?
negativeShe will not be coming.
polite questionWill you be staying long?

paragraphs: Form it with will have + the past participle. It looks back from a future time at an action that will already be finished by then. By and by the time are the usual time words.

blocks.html:
FormExample
statementI will have finished by six.
questionWill you have finished by then?
negativeThey will not (won't) have arrived.
with byBy next year, she will have graduated.

Future simpleFuture continuousFuture perfect
I'll work at nine. (a decision)I'll be working at nine. (in progress then)I'll have worked by nine. (done before nine)

items: Wrong: **I will have finish.** Right: **I will have finished.**
Wrong: **I will be work.** Right: **I will be working.**
Wrong: **By tomorrow, I will be finishing.** Right: **I will have finished.** (a completed action)

ro.title: Viitorul în desfășurare și viitorul anterior
ro.summary: Viitorul poate exprima o acțiune în desfășurare, iar viitorul anterior exprimă o acțiune încheiată înaintea unui alt moment viitor.

paragraphs: Limba română nu are o formă specială pentru viitorul continuu. Pentru o acțiune în desfășurare folosim viitorul simplu. Viitorul anterior arată o acțiune terminată înainte de un alt moment din viitor.

items: Mâine la ora două **voi zbura** spre Madrid.
Când vei sosi, eu **voi fi plecat** deja.

paragraphs: Pentru o acțiune continuă folosim formele standard de viitor împreună cu adverbe sau expresii de timp. Viitorul anterior se formează din viitorul verbului „a fi” și participiul verbului de bază. Forma de participiu rămâne neschimbată pentru toate persoanele.
